facts.claim: An assessment of twenty-five cents per share was levied on the capital stock of the Udley Mining Company on June 12, 1879.
facts.quote: Notice is hereby given that at a meeting of the Board of Directors, held on the 12th day of June, 1879, an assess- ment (No. 4) of twenty-five cents per share was levied upon the capital stock of the corpora- tion
